messages:
sarah (docs): heads-up — the nightly linkcheck failed for the mkdocs site. a bunch of anchors 404ing on /guides/model-onboarding. seems reproducible locally too
jamal (platform): ugh — any pattern in the anchors? broken fragments or missing files?
sarah (docs): fragments. quick grep shows the markdown contains a soft-hyphen (U+00AD) in a few headings — it was copied from a vendor doc and collapsed into the slug as \u00ad which mkdocs/markdown-it turns into a different slug id
lee (eng): interesting. soft-hyphen would be invisible in editor. can you paste an example?
sarah (docs): example heading raw: `## Model prerequisitesADand limits` -> slug becomes `model-prerequisitesADand-limits` and the HTML id != `model-prerequisites-and-limits` so linkcheck/link-to-anchor mismatches
liam (intern): i can make a quick script to strip non-printing hyphens and normalize whitespace across /docs. want me to open a PR?
sarah (docs): please. before PR, can we add a linkcheck test that treats control chars as errors so this doesn't regress?
jamal (platform): yes — add a step in the docs CI that runs `python ./tools/normalize_headings.py --check` (or similar), fail on non-ascii control chars in headings. also add a migration note in the PR template
lee (eng): for the quickfix, we can run sed on files: `sed -i 's/\xC2\xAD//g' **/*.md` — that'll strip soft hyphens (utf-8 encoding). liam, you can include that as the autofix in your PR
liam (intern): on it. i'll also add a small unit test: read all headings and assert `re.search(r"[\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F\u00AD]", heading) is None`
ci-bot: linkcheck job started for commit d3f4a2b
ci-bot: linkcheck output: 14 failed anchors (same group) — re-run after fixes
sarah (docs): PR drafted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — contains: remove soft-hyphens, add ci check, update CONTRIBUTING to call `tools/normalize_headings.py` before publish
jamal (platform): skimmed the script — can you make the check opt-in via `--fail-on-control-chars` flag so it won't break older branches? then we can flip it on main only
liam (intern): done. updated PR with flag and CI set to `--fail-on-control-chars` on main workflow only. also added a note in the changelog for deploy window
sarah (docs): @lee can you review the sed line and the CI YAML change? quick approve would be great, want this in the morning deploy
lee (eng): reviewing now. small nit: use git grep to list affected files in the PR description so we can eyeball them before mass replace. add that and i'm happy to approve
liam (intern): added `git grep -n $'\xC2\xAD' -- docs/ | sed -E 's/:.*$//' | sort -u` output to PR description
lee (eng): LGTM. approved. :thumbsup:
sarah (docs): merging after i run a manual `linkcheck --local` and confirm all anchors resolve. will follow up if anything else pops up
ci-bot: linkcheck job passed on branch (post-fix)
sarah (docs): merged and scheduled a patch deploy to staging. thanks team — nice catch, invisible unicode is the worst :sweat_smile:
